summary: Givens-aware in-schema: extract facts, then 7 questions
hypothesis: Extracting provided facts first (an easy reading task) and forbidding the 7 questions from re-asking any given should free wasted slots for real unknowns, because the model's coverage loss was assumed to come from re-stating already-known facts.
technique: A single on-device model call using an in-schema prompt that adds a `providedFacts` field first — pulling concrete facts from the task text — followed by the 7 questions constrained to never re-ask a given, all in one coherent draw (no separate refill pass), building on the exp011 base prompt.
